title: fix: cap community model prices
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Caps token-priced community models at 50 Pollen per 1M tokens.
- Caps fixed-price community image models at 0.25 Pollen per image.
- Enforces the limits in the API and dashboard price inputs.
- Adds boundary coverage for token and image pricing.

Checks:
- `biome check` on all changed files
- `git diff --check`

The focused local Worker test is currently blocked by an incomplete reused dependency tree (`stripe` missing); GitHub CI installs the locked dependencies.

gist.headline: Price ceilings, freshly installed
gist.blurb: The community model garden now has sensible price rails. Token models stop at 50 Pollen per million tokens, and image models stop at 0.25 Pollen per image.
gist.summary: Community endpoint pricing now caps token-priced models at 50 Pollen per 1M tokens and fixed-price image models at 0.25 Pollen per image, enforced in both the API and dashboard inputs.
gist.impact: People publishing and using community models get consistent upper price bounds, with the dashboard and API rejecting prices beyond those limits.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy community market garden with two clearly marked price fences: one beside a token-producing code plant labeled 50 Pollen / 1M, and another beside an image-flower printer labeled 0.25 Pollen / image. Polli, wearing a tiny gardener visor and holding a measuring tape, checks that the plants remain safely under their little wooden ceiling signs.
